description: Number lines let you depict numbers (or number ranges) with associated narrative. This can be an effective way to tell a story that involves progress to goal, relative values, explanation of values, and much more. This is extremely well-suited to building compelling infographics, and serves well as a gauge. There are a wide variety of formatting options, including: Can show discrete values or group values by tens, hundreds, thousands, etc. (user-defined or automatic) Optionally specify end values, thereby showing number ranges Locale/language sensitive formatting Option to use exponential/log scale Control over precision, currency and optional units Control colors through settings or data Categorization of values Option to show one number-line per category (10+ settings support this) Option to show horizontally or vertically Interactive filtering Display images alongside values Format settings such as how to delimit grouped values Many other size, shape, and layout settings (70+ settings available!)
